urn:eigenius:core:description: DepMap 18Q4 curated omics container (R serialization, readRDS). A named list of cell-line x gene matrices: DRIVE (RNAi dep), CRISPR (CERES dep), GE (log2 TPM expression), CN (log2 relative copy number), MUT_HOT/MUT_DAM/MUT_OTHER (binary mutation), MUT (mutation calls df), RPPA (protein). A multi-schema container consumed member-wise; not a single tabular layout.
